core_cards: Skirk Prospector; Goblin Matron; Mogg War Marshal; Gempalm Incinerator; Dralnu's Crusade; Empty the Warrens; Cryptic Gateway; Urza's Incubator; Goblin Turncoat; Festering Goblin; Deadapult; Sulfuric Vortex; Goblin Medics; Subterranean Scout
rationale: Pashalik Mons turns every Goblin death into damage and Skirk Prospector turns them into mana; Dralnu's Crusade ("All Goblins are black and are Zombies") lets Deadapult ("Sacrifice a Zombie: ...deals 2 damage") eat any Goblin, while Urza's Incubator and Cryptic Gateway cheat expensive Goblins like Siege-Gang Commander into play; Sulfuric Vortex is the cross-tag reach finisher that also shuts off opposing lifegain.
pitch: A relentless red swarm where dying Goblins are a resource, not a loss. Skirk Prospector sacrifices them for mana and Pashalik Mons turns each death into damage, while Siege-Gang Commander and Sulfuric Vortex push the last points through. Pick this if you love flooding the board and attacking without mercy.
pitch_es: Una implacable horda roja donde los Goblins que mueren son un recurso, no una pérdida. Skirk Prospector los sacrifica para obtener maná y Pashalik Mons convierte cada muerte en daño, mientras Siege-Gang Commander y Sulfuric Vortex empujan los últimos puntos. Elígelo si te gusta llenar la mesa y atacar sin piedad.
rationale_es: Pashalik Mons convierte cada muerte de un Goblin en daño y Skirk Prospector las convierte en maná; Dralnu's Crusade ("All Goblins are black and are Zombies") permite a Deadapult ("Sacrifice a Zombie: ...deals 2 damage") devorar cualquier Goblin, mientras Urza's Incubator y Cryptic Gateway ponen en juego Goblins caros como Siege-Gang Commander por atajos; Sulfuric Vortex es el rematador de alcance cruzado que también anula la ganancia de vida rival.

core_cards: Phyrexian Ghoul; Phyrexian Debaser; Zombie Infestation; Mogg War Marshal; Symbiotic Beast; Penumbra Bobcat; Necrosavant; Pyre Zombie; Dread Return; Gamekeeper; Mindslicer; Lieutenant Kirtar; Urborg Syphon-Mage; Spinal Embrace; Siege-Gang Commander; Skirk Prospector
rationale: Yawgmoth converts spare bodies into cards plus -1/-1 removal while Oversold Cemetery ("if you have four or more creature cards in your graveyard... return target creature card... to your hand") rebuys the fodder; cross-tag: Spinal Embrace steals a blocker you can feed to Phyrexian Ghoul before its own end-step sacrifice, and Mindslicer's death dumps hands when yours is already empty.
pitch: A grindy black deck that feeds its own creatures into a value machine. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician draws cards and shrinks blockers while Oversold Cemetery keeps handing your fodder back, so you win the long attrition war. For players who enjoy squeezing advantage out of every death.
pitch_es: Un mazo negro de desgaste que alimenta a sus propias criaturas a una máquina de valor. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician roba cartas y reduce bloqueadores, mientras Oversold Cemetery sigue devolviéndote forraje, para que ganes la larga guerra de desgaste. Para quienes disfrutan exprimir ventaja de cada muerte.
rationale_es: Yawgmoth convierte cuerpos sobrantes en cartas y eliminación con contadores -1/-1, mientras Oversold Cemetery ("if you have four or more creature cards in your graveyard... return target creature card... to your hand") recupera el forraje; como sinergia cruzada, Spinal Embrace roba un bloqueador que puedes alimentar a Phyrexian Ghoul antes de su propio sacrificio al final del turno, y la muerte de Mindslicer vacía las manos cuando la tuya ya está vacía.

core_cards: Mystic Enforcer; Werebear; Nantuko Monastery; Terravore; Glory; Vigilant Sentry; Mystic Zealot; Nomad Decoy; Krosan Restorer; Battlefield Scrounger; Seton's Desire; Nut Collector; Frantic Search; Millikin; Street Wraith; Fa'adiyah Seer; Entomb
rationale: Divine Sacrament, Mystic Enforcer, Werebear, Nantuko Monastery and friends all upgrade once "there are seven or more cards in your graveyard", and the cube's 20+ cycling cards plus Frantic Search/Millikin/Street Wraith fill the yard while replacing themselves; Glory grants color protection while sitting in the graveyard.
pitch: A patient GW midrange plan that gets dramatically better once seven cards fill your graveyard. Cheap self-mill and cycling switch on huge threats like Mystic Enforcer and Werebear, and Glory shields your team from the yard. Rewarding if you like decks that quietly power up and then take over.
pitch_es: Un plan de midrange GW paciente que mejora radicalmente cuando siete cartas llenan tu cementerio. El automill barato y el cycling activan amenazas enormes como Mystic Enforcer y Werebear, y Glory protege a tu equipo desde el cementerio. Gratificante si te gustan los mazos que se potencian en silencio y luego toman el control.
rationale_es: Divine Sacrament, Mystic Enforcer, Werebear, Nantuko Monastery y compañía mejoran cuando "there are seven or more cards in your graveyard", y las más de 20 cartas con cycling del cubo, junto con Frantic Search/Millikin/Street Wraith, llenan el cementerio mientras se reemplazan; Glory concede protección contra colores desde el cementerio.

core_cards: Sylvan Library; Enlightened Tutor; Auramancer; Sevinne's Reclamation; Mystic Remora; Hunting Grounds; Squirrel Nest; Divine Sacrament; Wild Growth; Seton's Desire; Veiled Serpent
rationale: Mesa Enchantress draws a card per enchantment cast and Zur the Enchanter puts any enchantment "with mana value 3 or less" straight onto the battlefield — Mystic Remora (1), Hunting Grounds (2), Sylvan Library (2), Divine Sacrament (3), Squirrel Nest (3); Sevinne's Reclamation and Auramancer rebuy them from the graveyard.
pitch: A calm engine deck built on enchantments that draw you cards as you cast them. Mesa Enchantress and Zur the Enchanter bury opponents in card advantage while Sylvan Library and Mystic Remora refill your hand. For players who want to build a machine and win on sheer resources.
pitch_es: Un sereno mazo de motor construido con encantamientos que te hacen robar cartas al lanzarlos. Mesa Enchantress y Zur the Enchanter entierran al rival bajo ventaja de cartas, mientras Sylvan Library y Mystic Remora reponen tu mano. Para quienes quieren construir una máquina y ganar por pura cantidad de recursos.
rationale_es: Mesa Enchantress roba una carta por cada encantamiento lanzado y Zur the Enchanter pone directamente en el campo de batalla cualquier encantamiento "with mana value 3 or less": Mystic Remora (1), Hunting Grounds (2), Sylvan Library (2), Divine Sacrament (3) y Squirrel Nest (3); Sevinne's Reclamation y Auramancer los recuperan del cementerio.

core_cards: Battle Screech; Call of the Herd; Squirrel Nest; Nut Collector; Symbiotic Beast; Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse; Empty the Warrens; Mogg War Marshal; Kavu Primarch; Congregate; Divine Sacrament; Rith, the Awakener; Siege-Gang Commander
rationale: Opposition converts token width into a full tap-down lock; Saproling Symbiosis, Battle Screech, and Squirrel Nest go wide while Divine Sacrament pumps the white tokens, Congregate ("2 life for each creature") and Kavu Primarch's convoke cash the width in, and Nut Collector's threshold makes every Squirrel a 3/3.
pitch: Go wide with a green-white army and overwhelm the table. Saproling Symbiosis and Battle Screech flood the board, Divine Sacrament pumps the team, and Opposition can tap the opponent out of the game entirely. Perfect if you like big boards and swinging with everything.
pitch_es: Ve ancho con un ejército verde-blanco y abruma la mesa. Saproling Symbiosis y Battle Screech llenan el campo, Divine Sacrament potencia al equipo y Opposition puede dejar al oponente completamente girado. Perfecto si te gustan las mesas grandes y atacar con todo.
rationale_es: Opposition convierte la amplitud de los tokens en un bloqueo total de permanentes; Saproling Symbiosis, Battle Screech y Squirrel Nest llenan el tablero, mientras Divine Sacrament potencia los tokens blancos, Congregate ("2 life for each creature") y el convoke de Kavu Primarch aprovechan esa amplitud, y el threshold de Nut Collector hace 3/3 a cada Squirrel.

core_cards: Entomb; Body Snatcher; Dread Return; Life // Death; Worldgorger Dragon; Gamble; Vampiric Tutor; Worldly Tutor; Gamekeeper; Zombie Infestation; Frantic Search; Denizen of the Deep; Arcanis the Omnipotent; Phantom Nishoba; Shivan Dragon
rationale: Entomb and Gamble (tutor plus random discard) stock the graveyard; Chainer, Dread Return, and Life // Death return the bodies while Sneak Attack cheats them in from hand; cross-tag: Worldly Tutor + Gamekeeper ("reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. Put that card onto the battlefield") cheats any creature from the library, and Arcanis, Denizen of the Deep, and Phantom Nishoba are untagged but textbook targets (huge bodies or a repeatable "{T}: Draw three cards").
pitch: Skip the mana and drop game-ending monsters early. Entomb and Gamble load your graveyard, then Chainer and Dread Return bring the fatties back while Sneak Attack slams them from hand. For players who want explosive, do-something-huge turns.
pitch_es: Salta el coste de maná y baja monstruos que terminan la partida temprano. Entomb y Gamble cargan tu cementerio, luego Chainer y Dread Return devuelven a los grandotes, mientras Sneak Attack los pone desde tu mano. Para quienes quieren turnos explosivos de hacer algo enorme.
rationale_es: Entomb y Gamble (tutor más descarte aleatorio) llenan el cementerio; Chainer, Dread Return y Life // Death devuelven los cuerpos, mientras Sneak Attack los pone desde la mano; como sinergia cruzada, Worldly Tutor + Gamekeeper ("reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. Put that card onto the battlefield") pone gratis cualquier criatura de la biblioteca. Arcanis, Denizen of the Deep y Phantom Nishoba son objetivos clásicos aunque no tengan etiqueta.

core_cards: Obsessive Search; Dark Withering; Ichor Slick; Aquamoeba; Zombie Infestation; Jalum Tome; Undead Gladiator; Urborg Syphon-Mage; Frantic Search; Mindslicer; Gamble
rationale: The four madness cards turn every discard outlet (Aquamoeba, Zombie Infestation, Jalum Tome, Vexing Sphinx's cumulative upkeep) into mana-discounted spells and Zombie tokens; a Mindslicer hand-dump is asymmetric when half your hand casts itself from exile.
pitch: A UB tempo deck that profits from throwing cards away. Discard outlets like Aquamoeba and Zombie Infestation cast your madness spells at a discount, turning your bin into a weapon. Great for players who enjoy clever, cost-cutting sequencing.
pitch_es: Un mazo UB de tempo que se beneficia de descartar cartas. Habilitadores como Aquamoeba y Zombie Infestation lanzan tus hechizos con madness por menos, convirtiendo el descarte en un arma. Ideal para quienes disfrutan secuenciar de forma ingeniosa y recortar costes.
rationale_es: Las cuatro cartas con madness convierten cada salida de descarte —Aquamoeba, Zombie Infestation, Jalum Tome y el upkeep acumulativo de Vexing Sphinx— en hechizos rebajados y tokens Zombie; una mano descartada por Mindslicer es asimétrica cuando la mitad de tu mano se lanza sola desde el exilio.

core_cards: Renewed Faith; Radiant's Judgment; Solar Blast; Slice and Dice; Spark Spray; Gempalm Incinerator; Lull; Break Asunder; Primal Boost; Macetail Hystrodon; Street Wraith; Undead Gladiator; Cloud of Faeries; Ichor Slick; Improvised Armor; Drifting Meadow; Remote Isle; Polluted Mire; Smoldering Crater; Slippery Karst; Elvish Aberration; Wild Dogs; Veiled Serpent; Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse; Grim Lavamancer
key_themes: Engine/Outlet payoffs on the cycling keyword; Graveyard cross-over
rationale: Lightning Rift and Invigorating Boon both trigger "whenever a player cycles a card" and the cube holds 20+ cyclers including five cycling lands; the same cycling doubles as Threshold fuel, cross-tag Jolrael converts each cycle draw into her "second card each turn" Cat trigger, and Grim Lavamancer ("Exile two cards from your graveyard") burns the spent cyclers.
pitch: A smooth WR midrange deck that never floods because everything cycles. Lightning Rift and Invigorating Boon turn each cycled card into free damage or growth, so you always have something to do. Ideal for players who like consistency and incremental value.
pitch_es: Un mazo WR de midrange fluido que nunca se inunda porque todo tiene cycling. Lightning Rift e Invigorating Boon convierten cada carta ciclada en daño o crecimiento gratis, así que siempre tienes algo que hacer. Ideal para quienes valoran la consistencia y el valor incremental.
rationale_es: Lightning Rift e Invigorating Boon se disparan "whenever a player cycles a card" y el cubo contiene más de 20 cartas con cycling, incluidas cinco tierras; ese cycling también alimenta Threshold, Jolrael convierte cada segundo robo por ciclo en su trigger de Cat y Grim Lavamancer quema usando los cicladores gastados.
key_themes_es: Recompensas de motor/salida con la palabra cycling; cruce con Graveyard

core_cards: Empty the Warrens; Storm Entity; Helm of Awakening; Turnabout; Snap; Frantic Search; Cloud of Faeries; Peregrine Drake; Lotus Blossom; Coal Stoker; Elvish Spirit Guide; Mystical Tutor; Overmaster; Stroke of Genius; Time Stretch; Last Chance; Force of Will
rationale: High Tide plus the free-untap suite (Turnabout, Frantic Search, Snap, Cloud of Faeries, Peregrine Drake) generates mana and storm count, Helm of Awakening discounts every spell, and Grapeshot / Empty the Warrens / Stroke of Genius convert the turn into a kill; Force of Will's alternative cost protects the combo turn while adding to storm, and Last Chance / Time Stretch buy the extra turn to finish.
pitch: A blue-red combo puzzle that ends the game in one big turn. High Tide and free untappers generate a mountain of mana, then Grapeshot or Empty the Warrens converts it into a kill. For players who love chaining spells toward a lethal finish.
pitch_es: Un rompecabezas combo azul-rojo que termina la partida en un solo turno grande. High Tide y enderezadores gratuitos generan una montaña de maná, y Grapeshot o Empty the Warrens lo convierten en una victoria. Para quienes aman encadenar hechizos hasta un final letal.
rationale_es: High Tide junto con la suite de enderezar gratis —Turnabout, Frantic Search, Snap, Cloud of Faeries y Peregrine Drake— genera maná y cuenta de storm; Helm of Awakening rebaja cada hechizo, y Grapeshot / Empty the Warrens / Stroke of Genius convierten el turno en victoria. El coste alternativo de Force of Will protege el turno de combo mientras suma a storm, y Last Chance / Time Stretch compran el turno extra para finalizar.

core_cards: Whitemane Lion; Sawtooth Loon; Man-o'-War; Flametongue Kavu; Peregrine Drake; Cloud of Faeries; Faceless Butcher; Wormfang Drake; Umbilicus; Body Snatcher; Cackling Fiend; Phyrexian Rager; Sun Clasp
rationale: Momentary Blink, Whitemane Lion, and Sun Clasp rebuy enter-the-battlefield triggers (Flametongue Kavu, Man-o'-War, Phyrexian Rager, Deadwood Treefolk's "enters or leaves the battlefield" recursion); cross-tag Umbilicus — its upkeep bounce ("they return a permanent they control to its owner's hand") is pure upside when your permanents want to re-enter.
pitch: A WU tempo-value deck that reuses enter-the-battlefield effects over and over. Momentary Blink and Whitemane Lion re-trigger creatures like Flametongue Kavu and Man-o'-War to grind opponents out. Satisfying if you like value engines and answering everything.
pitch_es: Un mazo WU de tempo y valor que reutiliza efectos de entrar al campo una y otra vez. Momentary Blink y Whitemane Lion vuelven a disparar criaturas como Flametongue Kavu y Man-o'-War para desgastar al oponente. Satisfactorio si te gustan los motores de valor y responderlo todo.
rationale_es: Momentary Blink, Whitemane Lion y Sun Clasp reutilizan disparos de entrar al campo —Flametongue Kavu, Man-o'-War, Phyrexian Rager y la recursión de Deadwood Treefolk al entrar o salir—; como sinergia cruzada, el rebote en upkeep de Umbilicus es pura ventaja cuando tus permanentes quieren volver a entrar.

core_cards: Windborn Muse; Crawlspace; Arboria; Maze of Ith; Icy Manipulator; Royal Assassin; Nomad Decoy; Mystic Remora; Damping Sphere; Umbilicus; Wrath of God; Absorb; Jester's Cap; Wall of Junk; Floodgate
rationale: No Mercy, Windborn Muse, Crawlspace, and Arboria make attacking miserable while Icy Manipulator and Nomad Decoy tap threats for cross-tag Royal Assassin ("Destroy target tapped creature"); Mystic Remora draws through it, Wrath of God resets, and Jester's Cap strips the opponent's win conditions in the attrition endgame.
pitch: A controlling WU lock-down deck that makes attacking you miserable. No Mercy and Windborn Muse punish aggression, Icy Manipulator taps threats, and Wrath of God resets the board before you close on card advantage. For players who enjoy saying no and winning slowly.
pitch_es: Un mazo WU de control y bloqueo que hace miserable atacarte. No Mercy y Windborn Muse castigan la agresión, Icy Manipulator gira amenazas y Wrath of God reinicia la mesa antes de que cierres con ventaja de cartas. Para quienes disfrutan decir no y ganar despacio.
rationale_es: No Mercy, Windborn Muse, Crawlspace y Arboria hacen que atacar sea penoso, mientras Icy Manipulator y Nomad Decoy giran amenazas para Royal Assassin ("Destroy target tapped creature"); Mystic Remora te hace robar, Wrath of God reinicia la mesa y Jester's Cap quita las condiciones de victoria rivales en el final de desgaste.

core_cards: Urza's Blueprints; Triskelion; Mishra's Factory; Mind Stone; Millikin; Jalum Tome; Lotus Blossom; Helm of Awakening; Icy Manipulator; Juggernaut; Dragon Engine; Ornithopter; Wall of Junk; Dodecapod; Legacy Weapon; Enlightened Tutor
rationale: Urza's Construct token "gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control" and "Tap an untapped artifact you control: Add {U}" turns Mind Stone, Millikin, and even Ornithopter into mana; Urza's Blueprints' echo {6} is trivial with that mana, and Triskelion is the top-end sink Enlightened Tutor can find.
pitch: A blue artifact deck that turns trinkets into a mana and card engine. Urza, Lord High Artificer makes a giant Construct and mana from your artifacts, powering out big payoffs like Triskelion. For players who like combo-adjacent value engines.
pitch_es: Un mazo azul de artefactos que convierte baratijas en un motor de maná y cartas. Urza, Lord High Artificer crea un Construct enorme y maná a partir de tus artefactos, alimentando grandes recompensas como Triskelion. Para quienes disfrutan motores de valor cercanos al combo.
rationale_es: El token Construct de Urza "gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control" y "Tap an untapped artifact you control: Add {U}", por lo que Mind Stone, Millikin e incluso Ornithopter se convierten en maná; el echo {6} de Urza's Blueprints es trivial con ese maná, y Triskelion es el sumidero de coste alto que encuentra Enlightened Tutor.

core_cards: Congregate; Lyra Dawnbringer; Spirit Link; Renewed Faith; Kjeldoran Gargoyle; Phantom Nishoba; Cleric of the Forward Order; Absorb; Gerrard's Verdict; Urborg Syphon-Mage; Sol'kanar the Swamp King
rationale: Test of Endurance wins the game at 50 or more life and Serra Avatar's "power and toughness are each equal to your life total"; Congregate, Lyra's lifelink aura, Spirit Link, and Kjeldoran Gargoyle do the gaining, with Sol'kanar taxing every black spell for extra life.
pitch: A resilient white deck that turns a huge life total into a win condition. Test of Endurance and Serra Avatar cash in the life gained by Congregate, Lyra Dawnbringer, and Spirit Link. For players who like outlasting opponents and flipping defense into offense.
pitch_es: Un mazo blanco resistente que convierte un total de vida enorme en condición de victoria. Test of Endurance y Serra Avatar aprovechan la vida ganada por Congregate, Lyra Dawnbringer y Spirit Link. Para quienes disfrutan sobrevivir al rival y transformar defensa en ataque.
rationale_es: Test of Endurance gana con 50 o más vidas y el "power and toughness are each equal to your life total" de Serra Avatar; Congregate, el aura de lifelink de Lyra, Spirit Link y Kjeldoran Gargoyle proporcionan la vida, mientras Sol'kanar grava cada hechizo negro para conseguir vida adicional.

core_cards: Terravore; Kamahl, Fist of Krosa; Krosan Restorer; Crop Rotation; Nature's Lore; Wild Growth; High Tide; Fa'adiyah Seer; Elvish Aberration; Squirrel Nest; Birds of Paradise
rationale: Exploration plus Tatyova turns every extra land drop into a card and a life; Terravore ("power and toughness are each equal to the number of land cards in all graveyards") feeds on the cube's cycling lands and Crop Rotation, while Kamahl and Squirrel Nest give flooded lands a job.
pitch: A GU ramp deck that makes every land drop pay off. Exploration and Tatyova, Benthic Druid turn extra lands into cards and life, while Terravore grows into a finisher off the graveyard. For players who enjoy accelerating ahead and grinding value.
pitch_es: Un mazo GU de ramp donde cada tierra que juegas genera valor. Exploration y Tatyova, Benthic Druid convierten tierras extra en cartas y vida, mientras Terravore crece hasta ser un rematador gracias al cementerio. Para quienes disfrutan acelerarse y obtener valor poco a poco.
rationale_es: Exploration junto con Tatyova convierte cada tierra adicional en una carta y una vida; Terravore ("power and toughness are each equal to the number of land cards in all graveyards") se alimenta de las tierras con cycling y Crop Rotation del cubo, mientras Kamahl y Squirrel Nest dan una función a las tierras sobrantes.

core_cards: Dragon Blood; Invigorating Boon; Phantom Nishoba; Phantom Flock; Kavu Primarch; Spiritmonger; Phyrexian Scuta; Yawgmoth, Thran Physician
rationale: Forgotten Ancient soaks a counter per spell and each upkeep may "move any number of +1/+1 counters from this creature onto other creatures" — onto Triskelion for direct damage or onto Phantom Flock / Phantom Nishoba to recharge their damage-prevention shields; Yawgmoth's proliferate and Dragon Blood keep the counters flowing.
pitch: A green counters deck that snowballs a single threat into a game-ender. Forgotten Ancient hoards counters and redistributes them onto Triskelion or the Phantoms, and proliferate keeps them flowing. For players who like building one unstoppable creature.
pitch_es: Un mazo verde de contadores que hace crecer una amenaza hasta convertirla en final de partida. Forgotten Ancient acumula contadores y los redistribuye sobre Triskelion o los Phantoms, y proliferate los mantiene fluyendo. Para quienes disfrutan construir una criatura imparable.
rationale_es: Forgotten Ancient recibe un contador por hechizo y en cada upkeep puede "move any number of +1/+1 counters from this creature onto other creatures": sobre Triskelion para daño directo o sobre Phantom Flock / Phantom Nishoba para recargar sus escudos de prevención. El proliferate de Yawgmoth y Dragon Blood mantienen los contadores en circulación.

core_cards: Crop Rotation; Exploration; Krosan Restorer; Vampiric Tutor
rationale: Dark Depths makes a legendary 20/20 flying indestructible token once its ten ice counters are gone; Crop Rotation ("Search your library for a land card, put that card onto the battlefield") fetches it, Exploration replays the land drops it eats, and Krosan Restorer's threshold untap helps pay the {3}-per-counter cost. Single-card anchor — speculate only with support.
pitch: A build-around combo that makes a 20/20 flying indestructible token out of nowhere. Crop Rotation fetches Dark Depths and green ramp helps clear its ice counters for a sudden knockout. A high-risk, high-reward pick for players who love a flashy one-card haymaker.
pitch_es: Un combo para construir alrededor que crea de la nada una ficha 20/20 voladora e indestructible. Crop Rotation busca Dark Depths y el ramp verde ayuda a quitar sus contadores de hielo para un golpe repentino. Una elección de alto riesgo y alta recompensa para quienes aman una amenaza espectacular de una carta.
rationale_es: Dark Depths crea una ficha legendaria 20/20 voladora e indestructible cuando se van sus diez contadores de hielo; Crop Rotation ("Search your library for a land card, put that card onto the battlefield") la busca, Exploration repone las caídas de tierra que consume y el enderezar de Krosan Restorer con threshold ayuda a pagar {3} por contador. Ancla de una sola carta: especula solo con apoyo.

keystones: Legacy Weapon; Sol'kanar the Swamp King
core_cards: Rith, the Awakener; Arcades Sabboth; Xira Arien; Gemstone Mine; Birds of Paradise; Crosis's Catacombs; Darigaaz's Caldera; Dromar's Cavern; Rith's Grove; Treva's Ruins; Lotus Blossom; Nature's Lore; Terminal Moraine; Wild Growth
rationale: Five Lair lands, Gemstone Mine, Lotus Blossom, and Birds of Paradise assemble WUBRG for the cube's gold top-end: Legacy Weapon's "{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}: Exile target permanent" becomes a repeatable removal engine, with Sol'kanar, Rith, Arcades Sabboth, and Xira Arien's card-draw sink as the payoffs the fixing earns.
pitch: A greedy five-color goodstuff deck powered by heavy fixing. Lair lands, Gemstone Mine, and Birds of Paradise let you cast every gold bomb, with Legacy Weapon as a repeatable removal engine. For players who want to play the biggest, splashiest cards in the cube.
pitch_es: Un ambicioso mazo five-color de buenas cartas impulsado por fijación abundante. Las tierras Lair, Gemstone Mine y Birds of Paradise te dejan lanzar cada bomba multicolor, con Legacy Weapon como motor repetible de eliminación. Para quienes quieren jugar las cartas más grandes y vistosas del cubo.
rationale_es: Cinco tierras Lair, Gemstone Mine, Lotus Blossom y Birds of Paradise reúnen WUBRG para la parte alta multicolor del cubo: "{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}: Exile target permanent" de Legacy Weapon se vuelve un motor repetible de eliminación, con Sol'kanar, Rith, Arcades Sabboth y el sumidero de robo de Xira Arien como recompensas por la fijación.

core_cards: Nantuko Shade; Shivan Dragon; Avarax; Dragon Whelp; Glintwing Invoker; Stonewood Invoker; Howl from Beyond; High Tide; Kamahl, Fist of Krosa
rationale: Gauntlet of Power pumps the chosen color and makes every basic of that color "add an additional one mana"; the cube is full of firebreathing-style sinks to spend it — Nantuko Shade and Shivan Dragon pump per mana, Howl from Beyond is an X-spell, and the Invokers carry 7-mana activations.
pitch: A single-color ramp deck that doubles your mana and dumps it into huge sinks. Gauntlet of Power supercharges your basics so firebreathers like Nantuko Shade and Shivan Dragon grow out of control. For players who like committing to one color and going tall.
pitch_es: Un mazo de ramp de un solo color que duplica su maná y lo invierte en grandes sumideros. Gauntlet of Power potencia tus básicas para que criaturas con firebreathing como Nantuko Shade y Shivan Dragon crezcan sin control. Para quienes disfrutan comprometerse con un color y crecer en vertical.
rationale_es: Gauntlet of Power potencia el color elegido y hace que cada tierra básica de ese color "add an additional one mana"; el cubo está lleno de sumideros estilo firebreathing para gastarlo: Nantuko Shade y Shivan Dragon se inflan por maná, Howl from Beyond es un hechizo X y los Invokers tienen activaciones de 7 manás.
key_themes_es: Payload/recompensas de sumideros de maná; bomba tribal por color

rationale: Horseshoe Crab's "{U}: Untap this creature" repeats any tap ability: with Hermetic Study ("{T}: This creature deals 1 damage to any target") every {U} is a ping, with Quicksilver Dagger it is a ping plus a card, and with Opposition every {U} taps an opposing permanent. Two-card engine — draft the pieces together.
pitch: A two-card blue engine that turns Horseshoe Crab into a machine gun. With Hermetic Study each untap is a ping, with Quicksilver Dagger it also draws a card, and with Opposition it locks down the board. A puzzle-piece build-around for players who love repeatable engines.
pitch_es: Un motor azul de dos cartas que convierte Horseshoe Crab en una ametralladora. Con Hermetic Study, cada enderezar es un ping; con Quicksilver Dagger también roba una carta; y con Opposition bloquea la mesa. Una construcción de piezas de rompecabezas para quienes aman los motores repetibles.
rationale_es: El "{U}: Untap this creature" de Horseshoe Crab repite cualquier habilidad de girar: con Hermetic Study ("{T}: This creature deals 1 damage to any target"), cada {U} es un ping; con Quicksilver Dagger es un ping más una carta; y con Opposition cada {U} gira un permanente rival. Motor de dos cartas: draftea las piezas juntas.
